name: Rose Colored Cover
source:
You can never expect everything, especially not waking up in someone's basement. Talking with an acquaintance had never come back to bite you until now. Lo and behold, you come face to face with a real yandere… But you’re not the one she’s after. Will you fight for your survival or give up and accept your demise? The choice is up to you... And her.

[From [url=https://phonyroni.itch.io/rose-colored-cover]itch.io[/url]]
